name: vllm-neuron-parity
description: Bring the vLLM-Neuron platform plugin fork to parity with upstream GPU vLLM: scan the upstream delta, cost each target's closing route, rank the backlog, and execute user-gated campaigns through correctness and performance gates against a GPU baseline into evidence-backed fork PRs. Ships the vllm-neuron-parity lead workflow skill, its six dispatched role agent types, and nine bundled Neuron skills that campaign seats load by plugin address (vllm-neuron-parity:<name>): the parallelism planner, NKI kernel writing, NKI documentation lookup, NKI device debugging, new-architecture compiler bring-up debugging, vLLM-Neuron model autoport (reference only), framework equivalence, vLLM serving benchmarks, and Neuron runtime troubleshooting.
compatibility: Requires Claude Code plugin hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionStart, SubagentStart) registered in hooks/hooks.json, the registered vllm-neuron-parity:* agent types, bash, and Python 3. The three blocking prohibition guards (P1 protected branches, P2 Neuron compile cache, P3 venv/opt), the graph edit guard (no direct edit of the live graph or revisions.yaml outside an apply step), the lead hook pair (stop guard with its audit-checkpoint branch, state-staleness reminder), the write log, the lead-only deny read from the graph's write_limits block and the hook-owned checkpoint files, the no-retry-copy rule, the re-entry dispatch advisory, the write-for-the-reader reminder, and the goal restatement at resume, compaction, and seat start all ride that hook runtime; without it the guards degrade to contract text and the lead's own resume, checkpoint, and write-for-the-reader duties, which is a recorded degradation, not a silent one. Graph validation (scripts/validate_pave.py) and the revision log tool (scripts/record_revision.py) additionally require pyyaml and jsonschema and fail closed without them; a successor revision also needs the pave-init plugin (2.6.0 or later) installed, because its pave-evolve seats draft and review every revision and its workflow-updater runs the audit checkpoint; run-state validation (scripts/validate_run_state.py) is full only with jsonschema and otherwise falls back to a labeled stdlib check that enforces the schema's declared keywords, including field length caps, and fails loudly on any keyword it cannot enforce. The nine bundled Neuron skills under skills/ are checked at run start by scripts/check_bundled_skills.py against skills_md5.txt; a missing or changed file is inputs_missing, except under neuron-framework-autoport-vllm-neuron, a competing tool whose absence is recorded and is never inputs_missing. The bundled copies carry the five conflict fixes VERSION 1.8.0 lists. Each skill's own requirements apply only at the nodes that load it: experimental-neuron-parallelism-planner - its CLI is standard-library python3, its oracle check and tests need torch (CPU meta device) and pytest, --visualize needs matplotlib, and sweep_results.json and the --emit and --visualize output go to PARALLELISM_PLANNER_OUTDIR, which the seat sets to its node's artifact directory; neuron-nki-writing and neuron-nki-debugging - an NKI venv (NKI 0.4 APIs, torch-neuronx with torch_xla, neuronx-cc) found through NKI_VENV_PATH or the venv the brief names, and for device runs a Neuron device under a job lease whose cores the seat sets as NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES; neuron-nki-docs - none, its documentation is bundled and offline; experimental-neuron-autoport-compiler-debugging-vllm-neuron - bash and a Neuron SDK venv (neuronx-cc; libneuronxla or neuronxcc for scan_hlo.py), its links to the experimental-neuron-perf-compiler-artifact-debugging skill do not resolve because that skill is not bundled, and a poisoned compile cache is left behind for a fresh cache root, never cleared (P2); neuron-framework-autoport-vllm-neuron - reference only, a competing tool and never a prerequisite, and it expects a vllm_neuron workspace, transformers, and Hugging Face access; neuron-framework-equivalence - a venv with torch, transformers, safetensors, numpy and neuronx-distributed, the external model_validation package (MODEL_VALIDATION_DIR) and the NeuroborosFoundations src tree its CPU templates import (NEUROBOROS_SRC), and for vllm_neuron targets the vllm-neuron editable install on PYTHONPATH and --target-stack vllm_neuron on every stage; its adapter was verified on vLLM 0.24.0 with the vllm-neuron 0.24 line and prints a compatibility note, not an exit, on any other line; experimental-neuron-framework-benchmark-vllm - vLLM's bench serve client against an already standing server, its GPU provisioning path (aws CLI with EC2 and S3 credentials, docker, InferencePerfAnalyzer) and its Kaizen path being out of scope under P6, and its deliverable scripts need pandas, matplotlib, tabulate and numpy; experimental-neuron-infra-runtime-troubleshooting - the Neuron SDK tools (neuron-ls, neuron-top, neuronx-cc) on the host, device commands only under a lease.
